title: 6.6 Can and Cannot
unit_outcome: Name places in town and ways to travel, say where places are, give simple directions, say what you can and cannot do, ask for help, and read simple bus and train times.
goal: Say what someone can or cannot do on the way: walk there, cross the street or go by train.
grammar_function: Subject + can / cannot + base verb: I can walk there. The boy cannot cross the street.
prerequisite: 6.2 walk, by and train; 6.5 cross the street; 5.10 Can I have...?
speaking_outcome: Say that I can or cannot do something.
